response.trustBoundary: Electricity, heat, customers and NPC decisions are simulated by this server and are reproducible from seed + action log. When chain mode is enabled, diesel purchases are real NEP-245 transfers on NEAR testnet from a merchant NPC account into the game's custodial vault; credits are an off-chain, non-redeemable game ledger. No contract verifies that electricity was produced.
